summary: Remote-controlled agent daemon with obfuscated network-to-shell/PTY dataflow
details: Package ships a self-executing daemon (`bin: whalent`) whose main bundle `dist/index.cjs` (13 MB) is heavily processed by javascript-obfuscator (string-array rotation, hex identifiers, control-flow flattening, ~1120-entry string array). The daemon connects to a WebSocket gateway (default Whalent platform, overridable via `--gateway`) and, per the package's own README, 'accepts remote commands (upgrade, restart) via the gateway'. The bundle imports `ws`, `node-pty`, `@xterm/headless`, `child_process`, and `ssh2`, and references loopback RDP/VNC ports (127.0.0.1:3389, 5900, 5901) — an architecture in which a remote WebSocket peer can drive local shell/PTY execution and remote-desktop/SSH connectivity on the host running the daemon. The obfuscation of the bundle conceals the network→exec dataflow and makes independent audit of what remote commands are accepted, and under what authentication, substantially harder. The daemon runs when the operator explicitly starts the `whalent` CLI (not on `npm install` or on `require`), so the surface is a runtime remote-control channel rather than an install-time compromise.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
